author: sentrivana
body_preview:

title: Remove extras
author: sentrivana
body_preview: We already stopped adding new extras. We should also get rid of the existing ones in the next major since they can indirectly make folks vulnerable to supply chain attacks if the package gets compromised, which is something that has been happening more and more recently.

body_preview:
